_doc: THE shared library of small reusable 'say this, link there' blocks, read by NT_Blocks (src/Content/class-blocks.php). Write a message ONCE here, then name its key anywhere you want it - a promo card, a nav dropdown, a footer column, a dialog, an article sidebar - and every placement updates together when you edit it. Fields per block: title, text, label (the click-here wording), url OR dialog (a key from dialogs.json), icon (NT_Icons name or emoji), image, tag (small-caps kicker), tone, new_tab. Use it with { "component": "promo-block", "args": { "block": "read_blogs" } } or { "args": { "blocks": ["read_blogs","visit_us"] } }. Per-placement tweaks: [{ "block": "visit_us", "label": "Find the counter" }]. The '_doc' key is ignored.
